2026_04_LAC_SEA.headline: The Chargers take their passing game north to challenge the defending champions
2026_04_LAC_SEA.paragraph1: The Chargers make a second straight road trip to face defending champion Seattle at Lumen Field, where communication and protection become immediate concerns. Los Angeles needs to keep its quarterback clean enough to attack a Seahawks defense that has conceded yardage through the air, while Seattle can stress the Chargers by creating negative plays and forcing longer down-and-distance. The Seahawks’ offense also benefits if its defense shortens the field, so Los Angeles must pair explosive passing opportunities with ball security and disciplined special-teams execution.
2026_04_LAC_SEA.model_rationale: Road communication and pass protection are central for Los Angeles, while Seattle can take control by creating negative plays and converting field-position advantages into sustained offense.
